Enumerations

The combinatorial objects a higher-order chain rule sums over, each in one copy so that an enumeration cannot disagree with itself.

Finite differences

One stencil library: weights from the Vandermonde system, offsets sized from order and accuracy, a balanced step, and an applicator that never composes lower-order differences.

fd_weights()
Finite-Difference Weights for Any Stencil

One Stencil, Applied

Quadrature and series

Integrals and sums vectorized over the parameters: one matrix evaluation for many parameter values, adaptivity batched by row, and NA with a named row where the requested accuracy cannot be reached.
